```
import os
import pytest
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http import Compression
from langfuse._client.span_processor import LangfuseSpanProcessor
from langfuse._client.environment_variables import LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION

def _get_compression_from_processor(processor):
    # Access underlying OTLPSpanExporter compression attribute
    return processor._batch_processor._span_exporter.compression

def test_compression_empty_env_means_none(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION, "")
    proc = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk",
        secret_key="sk",
        base_url="http://localhost",
    )
    try:
        assert _get_compression_from_processor(proc) == Compression.NoCompression
    finally:
        proc.shutdown()

def test_default_compression_is_gzip_when_no_env(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv(LANGFUSE_OTEL_COMPRESSION, raising=False)
    proc = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk",
        secret_key="sk",
        base_url="http://localhost",
    )
    try:
        assert _get_compression_from_processor(proc) == Compression.Gzip
    finally:
        proc.shutdown()
```
